summary: Executed four public backend auth/privacy regression tests and mobile Expo web smoke flow at 390x844.

integration_issues.issue: Google button was not checked before authentication because the script continued on the authenticated screen; callback was not exercised against Emergent.

action_items: Align frontend API configuration with the protected EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract; current code/env use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and extra.backendUrl.
Make sharing control rows interactive if privacy settings are intended to be user-changeable; current Sync controls are display-only despite /api/sharing existing.
Run a dedicated unauthenticated Google/deep-link callback test with a valid Emergent session fixture.
critical_code_review_comments: All tested protected APIs use opaque server sessions and sanitized users; no password hash was returned.

Frontend stores the token in web AsyncStorage through secure* helpers, which is not secure storage on browsers; this is an inherent web fallback and should be accepted only for preview, not treated as production secret storage.
Google OAuth is a real external integration, but was not mocked and could not be completed in this run without an external OAuth session.

success_rate.frontend: 100% tested core flow (load, login, task create, Sync, overflow, console); Google callback not exercised

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed accounts/items/pair through regression tests; no seeded production records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview loaded at 390x844. Email login reached Today, task creation worked, Sync/sharing rendered, no horizontal overflow or console errors. Existing test account was read from test_credentials.md.
rca_of_issue: Configuration mismatch: frontend/index.tsx constructs API from Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the environment contract and review request name EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Preview succeeds only because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is currently present. Google callback requires an actual Emergent OAuth session ID and was therefore not independently verified.
